Karsemine begins to look for a good place to camp, but can't help wondering more about the mysterious puddles. She asks Caelynn for help and she casts Detect Magic using her Whisper Bottle. Magic seems to be coming from everywhere, but she is able to see that the magic in the puddle is from conjuration. Caelynn takes a small vial with her and Karsemine pokes the puddle with a stick. Just then Bonogo leaps over them both and lands in the puddle, splashing everyone with water. They hold their breath waiting for something to change, but nothing else happens. So they continue to the next hill, looking for a good place to stop for the night.
